Original CC0 artwork derived from `../shaping-font/Shaping.ttf` by FontTools.
All outlines except GID8 `acutecomb` are emptied. Character mappings, glyph IDs,
advances, vertical metrics, GSUB, GPOS and GDEF remain byte-identical to the
original tables; the generator asserts this after saving. The original global
font bounds remain intact. Only the reference name and ink change.

Run `python3 tests/fixtures/native-layout/generate.py` with FontTools installed.
The manifest retains both byte identities. This fixture independently observes
native mark placement through text metrics; it is never used by product code.
